description: The defect is that positional-v0 silently misassociates verdicts when the model returns a different count or order. This parser refuses on count mismatches (checking before any association), detects truncation via finish_reason, and supports both positional (when counts match) and keyed protocols (matching by article_id). It validates scores are finite and in [0,1] range, refusing with specific kinds from REFUSAL_KINDS vocabulary.
